# design-component

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Reuse existing components. Identify semantics, variants, sizes, and applicable
default/hover/focus/active/disabled/loading/error/selected states. Use
../components/ and ../accessibility/aria-patterns.md for relevant patterns.
Share implementation and preserve overlay Escape/focus-return behavior.
Verify the actual app component with long content and mobile wrapping.
A standalone harness is useful only when it adds coverage.
